purpose: Independent Prediction, Biological Architecture & Canonical Integration

phase1_parameter_forensics.true_measurement_type: Analytical estimate from TEM hexagonal microfibril lattice (d=7.2 nm, a=9.6 nm)
phase1_parameter_forensics.scientific_critique: Not directly measured coupon-by-coupon, but structurally realistic for alpha-keratin.

phase1_parameter_forensics.true_measurement_type: TEM microfibril volume estimate in intertubular horn (reported range 0.48 - 0.55)
phase1_parameter_forensics.scientific_critique: Midpoint literature estimate of intertubular hoof keratin microfibrillar volume.

phase1_parameter_forensics.true_literature_source: Wang et al. (2016) / Liu et al. (2016) JMBBM 56:165-174 (Fig 2)
phase1_parameter_forensics.true_measurement_type: CROSS-SECTIONAL THICKNESS FRACTION OF VENTRAL MACRO-LAYER
phase1_parameter_forensics.scientific_critique: CRITICAL CULPRIT IDENTIFIED: In Wang 2016, the scale thickness is divided into three macro-layers: dorsal (~42%), middle (~20%), and ventral (~38%). Cycle 8 mistakenly took this 38% ventral layer thickness fraction and assigned it as the nanoscale volume fraction of intermediate filaments (Phi_IF)! True nanoscale filament fraction in pangolin scale keratin cells is 50-55%, identical to other alpha-keratins.

phase1_parameter_forensics.true_literature_source: Classical laminate theory (Krenchel fiber orientation factor)
phase1_parameter_forensics.true_measurement_type: Analytical laminate plate theory: sum(V_k * cos^4(theta_k)) for [+-45] crossed-ply
phase1_parameter_forensics.scientific_critique: Mathematically sound analytical derivation for balanced crossed-lamellar layup, but not an empirical coupon measurement.

phase1_parameter_forensics.true_literature_source: Wang et al. (2016) SEM / micro-CT cross-sections
phase1_parameter_forensics.true_measurement_type: Direct micro-CT and SEM histology confirming complete absence of hollow medullary tubules
phase1_parameter_forensics.scientific_critique: Accurate and verified. Pangolin scales are solid, non-tubular cornified plates.

phase1_parameter_forensics.true_literature_source: Trim et al. (2011) Acta Biomater 7:1228-1240 (Table 1, Fig 6)
phase1_parameter_forensics.true_measurement_type: Quasistatic longitudinal uniaxial compression/tension on vacuum/oven-dry bighorn horn (w ~ 0 - 0.02)
phase1_parameter_forensics.scientific_critique: Verified for desiccated oven-dry horn. However, in ambient-stored horns (w ~ 10-12 wt.%), Huang et al. (2018) measured compressive longitudinal modulus of 1.7 +/- 0.5 GPa and tensile modulus of 1.15 GPa, demonstrating that 4.6 GPa is specific to desiccated horn coupons.

dataset_metadata.source: Huang et al. (2018) J. R. Soc. Interface 15:20180217 (PMC6030630)

unmodified_cycle8_performance.failure_mechanism: Unmodified Cycle 8 Voigt composite model systematically overpredicts hydrated horn modulus because it ignores matrix-softening-induced lamellar microbuckling.

arithmetic_divergence_explained.root_cause_of_divergence: Cycle 8 report reported 56.0% which was derived from the fold-by-fold cross-validated training baseline (mean baseline MAE = 1.609 GPa -> (1.609 - 0.708) / 1.609 = 55.99%), while simultaneously printing the static full-dataset baseline of 1.419 GPa in the table.
